findings.en: Two remarks. The principle gives exact ordinates only for statically determinate structures, where the released structure is a mechanism of straight rigid links; for an indeterminate beam the released structure bends and the principle gives the shape only. And the kinks of the deflected shape lie at the hinges and at the released restraint, never inside a rigid member: a quick visual check of any influence line you compute.
findings.ms: Dua catatan. Prinsip ini memberi ordinate yang tepat hanya bagi struktur statically determinate, di mana released structure ialah mechanism yang terdiri daripada rigid link yang lurus; bagi beam indeterminate, released structure melentur dan prinsip ini hanya memberi bentuk. Selain itu, bengkokan pada deflected shape terletak di hinge dan di restraint yang dilepaskan, tidak sekali-kali di dalam anggota rigid: semakan visual yang pantas bagi mana-mana influence line yang anda kira.

findings.en: How to compare. Report the difference \(\eta_{\text{test}}-\eta_{\text{theory}}\) at every halt. A percentage difference is meaningful only where the theoretical ordinate is not small: at halt 2, where \(\eta_A = 0.2\), a gauge error of one division (0.02 per unit load) is already 10 %, and where the theoretical value is zero the percentage is undefined. Judge the agreement by the absolute difference and by the shape of the line.
findings.ms: Cara membandingkan. Laporkan perbezaan \(\eta_{\text{test}}-\eta_{\text{theory}}\) pada setiap halt. Perbezaan peratusan hanya bermakna apabila ordinate teori tidak kecil: di halt 2, di mana \(\eta_A = 0.2\), error gauge satu division (0.02 per unit load) sudah 10 %, dan apabila nilai teori sifar, peratusan tidak tertakrif. Nilai persetujuan berdasarkan perbezaan mutlak dan bentuk garis.
